messages:
rachel: hey team, first-week onboarding hiccup. i triggered the `ml-evals` pipeline and the checkout step failed with a 403 and a `Bad credentials` message. i'm pretty sure i accepted the org invite and added my SSH key. any ideas?

ben: welcome rachel! can you paste the small checkout log? also did you push a branch upstream or are you working from a fork?

rachel: clipped log: ```
Cloning into 'ml-evals'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/redwood/ml-evals.git/'
ERROR: exit status 128
Exception: git fetch failed: exit status 128
Details: HTTP 403 - Bad credentials
```

ari: quick thought: we recently rolled org-wide policy to disallow classic PATs for machine users. some Buildkite agent pools still use a machine user PAT for mirror clones; if that token was revoked or replaced with a fine-grained token that doesn't grant repo access, you'll see 403 Bad credentials.

rachel: ah — i noticed a deploy key config in the pipeline step too. not sure which mechanism the agent used.

ben: yep, this pipeline runs on our legacy "mirror" agent pool that uses a service account token to mirror repos. security rotated the PAT last night and the agent didn't pick up the new credentials. infra should rotate the token on the pool and prefer the GitHub App install for clones.

infra-bot: infra:incident created #3012 "Mirror agent pool failing - machine user PAT rotated; update pool credentials" (assigned: ben)

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `ml-evals/push` #5 failed on job `checkout` — exit code 128

ben: i'm going to deploy a fix: 1) replace the pool PAT with the new service token (with fine-grained repo read access), 2) switch the mirror pool to use the org GH App for future clones, and 3) re-run your build. give me a few mins.

ari: also note for onboarding: we should call out that some older agent pools still rely on machine user tokens and that security rotation can temporarily break CI. new hires should try re-running after a few minutes and ping #eng-infra if it persists. we'll update docs to prefer SSH/GH App and avoid manual PATs.

rachel: thanks — re-run succeeded! pipeline advanced past checkout. :tada:

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `ml-evals/push` #6 succeeded on job `checkout` — duration 47s

ben: root cause summary for docs: machine-user PAT on mirror agent pool was rotated by security and agent credential refresh failed; fix was to update pool credentials and schedule migration to org GH App. onboarding checklist item: if you hit 403 Bad credentials on first-run, 1) wait a few minutes and retry, 2) check SSH key and team membership, and 3) ping #eng-infra if it still fails so infra can check agent pool tokens.

rachel: i'll add that note to the onboarding doc PR i'm preparing. thanks for the quick fix!

ari: closing incident #3012 — follow-up task: migrate mirror pool to GH App (tracked in infra backlog).
